title: Qualify finite concentrator and multiradio resources
description:
Qualify the actual selected concentrator or multiradio configuration's usable passbands, channel banks, demodulator allocations, RX chains and TX concurrency. If no such configuration is selected or available, record it as excluded/unassessed without procuring equipment or inventing a successful test.

HPC8 execution policy: Code, test, or schema changes require three independent correctness, security, and robustness reviews; file and fix all findings and re-review. Use independent oracles, never weakened legacy tests or self-generated expected results. Preserve upstream Yggdrasil addressing, radio-owned identity, best-effort custody, baseline SCHC, and the human-only OSCORE/EDHOC security edit bar. External actions, hardware/RF operations, and port access require scoped explicit permission and applicable bench safety checks. Research may conclude no-go; an authorization gate requires affirmative, recorded approval for its actual scope. Dependency closure and decomposition are not permission. No speculative activation, including deferred portability or experimental modes.
design: Before physical access or RF, require affirmative matching authority.10 and rf.03 approvals for the selected equipment/session. No implicit contact, purchase or live shared-bench concurrency. Documentary no-assessment is permitted without RF; lack of clearance keeps actual execution blocked or deferred.
acceptance_criteria: Primary hardware limits and independent simultaneous-arrival/overload traces establish tested resource bounds and exhaustion behavior. A 128-entry plan is not 128-channel reception. Ordinary-LoRa evidence does not qualify LR-FHSS; any LR-FHSS claim requires separately demonstrated lrfhss-series receiving capability.
